title: An exploration weight changes the score
hook: Two stated cases: explore the uncertainty bonus in a declared acquisition rule.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the uncertainty bonus in a declared acquisition rule affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Score, regardless of the stated inputs.
